segments.he:
תּוֹרָה עז
הַכְּלָל הוּא, כָּל מַה שֶּׁאָנוּ עוֹשִׂים הֵן הַתְּפִלָּה וְהֵן לִמּוּד, הוּא כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה מַלְכוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ:
segments.en: The primary honour of Shabbos is the eating of Shabbos. For Shabbos eating is very precious. For it is entirely divinity — entirely holy. Therefore it is a great commandment to increase in Shabbos eating. And it is a rectification for desecration of Shabbos.
